title: How Access Control Hierarchies & Role Systems Works
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    subgraph Roles["Role Hierarchy"]
        A["DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE"] --> B["grantRole / revokeRole"]
        B --> C["OPERATOR_ROLE"]
        B --> D["PAUSER_ROLE"]
    end
    E["Caller EOA"] --> F["Privileged setter"]
    F --> G{"Auth modifier present?"}
    G -->|"onlyRole / onlyOwner"| H["Check msg.sender principal"]
    G -->|"none"| J["Unguarded entry"]
    H -->|"authorized"| I["Mutate privileged state"]
    H -->|"denied"| K["Revert"]
    C --> H
    D --> H

title: Attack Vector
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    X["Attacker EOA"] --> M{"Failure mode"}
    M -->|"V1 missing modifier"| A1["Call unguarded setter"]
    M -->|"V2 modifier dropped in refactor"| A2["Call wide-open function"]
    M -->|"V3 no per-account check"| A3["Cancel any users order"]
    M -->|"V4 tx.origin == owner"| A4["Phish owner via contract"]
    M -->|"Unprotected initialize()"| A5["Win init race, seize owner"]
    M -->|"Stolen owner key"| A6["Sign as owner EOA"]
    A1 --> Z["Write privileged state"]
    A2 --> Z
    A3 --> Z
    A4 --> Z
    A5 --> Z
    A6 --> Z
    Z --> R["Drain, brick or seize protocol"]

title: Defense Pattern
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    subgraph Guard["Authorization gate"]
        A["Gate every state setter"] --> B["Add onlyRole / onlyOwner"]
        B --> C["Use msg.sender, never tx.origin"]
    end
    subgraph Role["Role design"]
        D["Override grantRole wrappers"] --> E["Block inherited public grantRole"]
    end
    subgraph Init["Upgrade safety"]
        F["Use initializer modifier"] --> G["Guard _authorizeUpgrade"]
    end
    subgraph Keys["Key hygiene"]
        H["Owner = multisig / timelock"] --> I["Rotate keys, watch transfers"]
    end
    C --> J["Diff modifiers each upgrade"]
    E --> J
    G --> J
    I --> J
    J --> K["Privileged state protected"]
